source_references.title: AI-native finance transformation at Lucid: PwC

business_problem: Lucid needed finance to move beyond retrospective reporting and become a faster, data-driven decision partner that could support growth with better forecasting, scenario planning, and capital visibility.
solution_summary: Lucid used finance as the entry point for an AI-native operating model. PwC combined its finance transformation expertise, AI capabilities, and agent OS with Amazon Web Services to turn Lucid’s cloud environment and operational data into AI-enabled forecasting and reporting workflows. Cross-functional AI pods built machine-learning models, intelligent agents, and finance copilots that automate forecasting, reconciliation, analytics, and monitoring while still allowing humans to refine assumptions as market conditions change. The initial implementation reduced end-to-end demand forecasting and scenario modeling from weeks to less than a minute, then expanded into an AI-enabled executive concierge that surfaces trends, insights, and capital-investment visibility for leadership. What started in finance is now a repeatable pattern for procurement and operations, with 14 AI use cases scaled in 10 weeks across the enterprise.

data_flow: Lucid operational and finance data flows from its cloud environment into AWS-based AI workflows where PwC’s agent OS, ML models, and intelligent agents automate forecasting, scenario planning, reconciliation, and monitoring. Outputs feed reporting tools and an AI-enabled executive concierge that surfaces insights and capital-investment visibility for leaders.
business_outcome: Lucid cut forecast and scenario-generation cycles from weeks to less than a minute, scaled 14 AI use cases in 10 weeks, and created an executive concierge that gives leadership faster visibility into trends and more than $1 billion in capital investments.

evidence_quotes: Alongside PwC’s finance and AI capabilities and Amazon Web Services (AWS), Lucid rapidly prototyped AI-enabled forecasting and reporting tools that helped reduce the end-to-end cycle time from weeks to less than a minute.

This momentum has enabled Lucid to scale 14 AI use cases in 10 weeks—automating forecasting workflows, reconciliation, analytics, and monitoring—while freeing teams to focus on strategic analysis, risk assessment, and more.
Together, we’ve built intelligent agents that can accelerate insight while preserving human judgment—like the ability to refine assumptions based on changing market conditions.
PwC also helped our team develop an AI-enabled executive concierge.
The new agent surfaces insights and forecasts trends to assist faster, more confident leadership decisions, including visibility into over $1B in capital investments.
